requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Vagueness in 'dial tone' resolved by context constraint CST-01. Requirement structured as a functional requirement specifying the required frequency components.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate a tone matching the North American telephony standard using simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz.
structuring_notes: The original vague requirement 'Generate a dial tone' was resolved using the supported interpretation from AMB-01, incorporating the specific frequencies (350 Hz and 440 Hz) mandated by context constraint CST-01.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not assume the duration of the tone, as the context only specifies the required frequencies.
